queueEmptied.note: This batch empties the special grade whole-stroke review queue. Every special grade character that has a pinned dictionary title, consistent source metadata and at least one licensed corpus carrying the catalog stroke count has now been reviewed stroke by stroke. Five glyphs are held for glyph-form differences (靚, 褊, 諞, 牖, 扆) and 653 have no licensed source at all, so they remain out of reach without a new corpus.

corpusOverrides.note: Both started from the Japanese file and both are 隹. Ja writes the bars of the 隹 body in a different order (three strokes over 60°, max 94° and 99°); MM writes the bars first and leaves one stroke each, the top-right tick, which was redrawn. 睢 was considered for an MM → Hans override but both corpora leave exactly one stroke over the threshold — 74° against 73° — so the starting corpus was kept and the tick was redrawn there too.

directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors
directionProbe.note: 矍 and 攜 shrank from three flagged strokes to one when the corpus changed; no glyph lost its last flag that way. 薈, 殽 and 豨 were resolved by reordering and 矍, 詡, 睢 and 攜 by an authored path. The endpoint assignment check found no order difference the angle probe had missed. Recomputed against the published order and paths, no stroke is over 60°.

subThresholdSlants.method: direction-probe rows recomputed against the published order and paths: 2 rows between 45° and 60°, none corrected
subThresholdSlants.note: Two short opening dots the dictionary draws steeper than the licensed corpora (効 1 at 51°, 襭 1 at 52°). Kept as licensed geometry, as in the earlier batches. The smallest sub-threshold count of any special grade batch.

sourceTransform.note: No dictionary group in this batch carries a horizontal offset; every transform is translate(0, -y).
